summary: Leave Calendar page tested end-to-end via UI. All 8 acceptance criteria PASS. Page loads at /battalion-chief/leave-calendar, displays monthly grid (August 2026), color-coded vacation entries on 08/14 & 08/15 (and 08/17-18 from other seed records), filters (leave type, shift, station) update stats and grid correctly, prev/next/today month navigation works, clicking a day with leaves opens the detail dialog showing Firefighter Test User / Station 10 / Vacation / 08/14/2026-08/15/2026 with notes 'Family vacation - taking kids to the lake', stats cards show 4/0/0/4 (vacation/sick/holiday/total), shift indicators A/B/C appear on every day cell, and the legend shows leave-type & shift color coding.

issues: DialogContent missing `Description` or `aria-describedby` (a11y warning in console) - non-blocking but should add DialogDescription for screen readers.

action_items: (Optional/A11y) Add DialogDescription to Day Detail Dialog to eliminate Radix `aria-describedby` warning.

(Observation, not a bug) Dialog shows person shift as 'A Shift' for Test User at Station 10 while iteration_20 context noted Test User as 'B Shift'. LeaveCalendar renders whatever `person.shift` is in personnel data; if source-of-truth changed, verify personnel record. Note also the C Shift filter yielded 0 records - consistent with Test User NOT being C shift.
critical_code_review_comments: LeaveCalendarPage.js line 46-53: fetch triggers on every currentMonth change; response is re-fetched even when the visible week-window range hasn't changed materially. Consider memoizing start/end string keys as dependency. Minor perf item.

Line 101 filters by `person.station_id` (id) but the Station select uses the same station_id value, so filter works. However station labels use string manipulation `stationId.replace('sta-','Station ').replace(/-/g,' ')` (line 235) - fragile if id format changes; prefer looking up label from `stations` context.
Line 442 `leave.leave_type.charAt(0).toUpperCase()...` will crash if leave_type is null. Add nullish guard.
Only approved leaves are shown (line 104). This is intentional but should be surfaced in UI (e.g., an empty-state note) so users don't think pending leaves are missing due to a bug.
Stats count days-per-approved-leave-entry per rendered date, which is correct for calendar-visible days but includes overlap days from previous/next month rows. Acceptable for a calendar view.
